page.layout: One engraved bookplate in the centre of the page: a coat of arms within a framed plate, with a printed caption of two lines in the lower border. No other printed text.
page.notes: Engraved bookplate (ex-libris) with a coat of arms: a lion crest holding a staff above a castle-shaped crest, shield of diagonal bands with small roundels, within a rococo cartouche. The caption is engraved in italic. Manuscript inscription at the top of the page, which is handwriting and therefore omitted. Paper creases and staining, plus show-through in the lower half. The caption's "Northampton Shire" is probably a single word, "Northamptonshire", set with a space by the engraver; left as printed.
